case.preset_source: original Transolver launchers + industrial main constructors; CDLNO configs/CDLNO/*.json (v1.2), not old parser defaults

cost_convention: Forward dense matrix MAC: one multiply-accumulate=2 FLOPs. Conv includes padded taps. Matrix FLOPs exclude bias/norm/activation/softmax/reductions/copies; these have separate inventories. SDPA QK+AV counted from actual shapes. No claim of exact all-operation FLOPs. Storage payload/activation ledgers are not summed into measured allocator peaks.
exclusions: No data, graphs, task loss, temporal rollout, scheduler, epoch estimate or LRSA paper reproduction.

config.preset_source: original Transolver launchers + industrial main constructors; CDLNO configs/CDLNO/*.json (v1.2), not old parser defaults

storage.current_latent_payload_note: FP32 residual representation; actual mixed activation dtypes in norm/SDPA ledgers
storage.saved_storage_excludes: parameters, buffers, input backing storage; not allocator peak

untimed_eager_profiler.partial_flops_warning: not total FLOPs; SDPA and other unsupported ops can be omitted

measurement.timing: synchronized perf_counter; includes host launch/wrapper overhead; no data I/O
measurement.loss: synthetic FP32 mean squared error, one model call/update; not task loss/temporal rollout
measurement.memory_scope: forward: model+buffers+inputs+output/temporaries, no grads/optimizer; train: also grads+initialized AdamW states
